## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:给中继出队(dequeue)补一条自测——出队后第二次读 PR 失败时不算确认、整对重读;两处函数注释改成"读两次";插队的"携带批准"评论只要任一行带席位签名就拒收(原来只看首行)。
- 为什么改:这是 PR #33732 复审留下的三条小尾巴(E2、E3、D3),注释与文件头不一致,签名藏在第二行就能绕过"席位评论不算维护者批准"。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `scripts/pm/fleet-write/` 两个脚本,不发布;D3 只会让更多评论被拒、不会放宽;回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` 的 `enqueueFrontSizeLift`(逐行读签名那一行);`execute.mjs` 自测里新增的 "a SECOND pull read that fails" 一行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test`,应看到 "424 cases pass across 31 batteries"。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Three items of the #33768 checklist (review follow-ups of PR #33732). The rest stay open on the card: the `fleet-write.yml` comment and the AGENTS.md sentence (Tier H, a later governed batch), N1/E1 (measured at the first live stroke), D2, D4 and N2 (each needs a budget or a ruling).

- **E2** (`execute.mjs` self-test). The rows near the dequeue read-back pinned a failed FIRST pull read (`pullLate`: 502, ok) and a merge that shows only on the second read (`mergedLate`), but no failed SECOND read. New row: pull reads ok, 502, ok, ok. The 502 confirms nothing, so the queue is read again at the interval and the pair starts over. It lands at three polls (clock `3 * DEQUEUE_POLL_MS`), with 5 pull GETs and 4 GraphQL calls. The pr_dequeue battery pin goes 28 → 29, with a roster comment.
- **E3** (jsdocs). `dequeueAction` now says the pull's own GET reads it open and unmerged TWICE, one `pollMs` apart, and that a failed second read starts the pair over. `dequeuePullAfter` now says it judges ONE of the two reads and the executor lands only when both are `ok`. Both match the file headers.
- **D3** (optional hardening, taken: it stays inside `scripts/pm/fleet-write/**`). `enqueueFrontSizeLift` runs the passed-in signature reader on every line of the `approval_comment`, not only the first non-empty one. A seat signature on any line refuses the carry, and the reading says "holds the seat signature". The row "⭐ CARRIED, the other way: … signature line further down … still carries it" flips to "⛔ CARRIED, refused on ANY line", which also checks that the reading names the seat. The SIZE lift battery stays at 12 cases; its name ("holding a seat signature on any line"), the `ops.mjs` header paragraph and the `execute.mjs` header sentence now say any line. The reader stays passed in, so `ops.mjs` still imports no guard.

No changeset: the diff is `scripts/pm/**` only and publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).

## Tests

At head 1c433b21:

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test`: 424 cases pass across 31 batteries (423 at base c3c0c30d).
- Forced test edit: the D3 row "signature line further down still carries it" is flipped to a refusal, as the card asks.

<details><summary>Ablations (both red on exactly the new pin, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

Run with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor must hit, restore is checked on disk) after the fix was committed.

- E2: the second read's `if (after.ok) return` changed to `if (after.ok || after.pending) return`. Result: `✗ a SECOND pull read that fails (ok, 502) … — got [0,3000,3,3], want [0,9000,5,4]`, 1 of 424 failed.
- D3: the line scan changed back to `signatureOf(c.body)` (first line only). Result: `✗ ⛔ CARRIED, refused on ANY line … — got [[0,1,200],false], want [[5,0,"not sent"],true]`, 1 of 424 failed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Concurrency: PR #33975 (self-test fixtures near L2909–2962) and PR #34022 (removes the mailbox lock rows and battery, so the battery floor goes 31 → 30) also touch `execute.mjs`. Their hunks do not overlap these. Whichever lands later rebases; the floor and the per-battery pins here move independently of #34022's.
